mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, we are seeing clear skies near Harriet Park. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
The Public Works Department is hard at work maintaining our city streets and utilities, and you can stay informed on their efforts by subscribing to the official City of Verona newsletter online.

There is plenty to do in town with Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee all happening today. Looking ahead, Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory is coming up tomorrow.
In a report regarding service calls from earlier this month, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash occurred in a parking lot on East Verona Avenue, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
